hook:
The test I set myself:
log a meal without looking down

beats.aside: (sat at a table with other people)
beats.claim: Hold the mic. Say the sentence.
beats.reason: Describing lunch out loud is the same thing you would say to a friend, so nothing needs translating.
The screen asks what you have eaten today and then gets out of the way until you answer it.
Calories, protein, carbs and fat land on their own screen rather than interrupting you mid-meal.
